# The Economic Times

> > India's leading business and economic news platform covering markets, industry, policy, manufacturing, pharma, energy, and financial services.

The Economic Times provides comprehensive coverage of Indian business news across specialized verticals including manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, energy, and banking. It serves as a key resource for industry insights, policy updates, regulatory reforms, and sector-specific analysis for business professionals and decision-makers.

## Key Topics

- India
- Special Economic Zones (SEZ)
- SEZ 2.0 Policy Reforms
- Industrial AI
- Renewable Energy
- Clean Energy Manufacturing
- Export Promotion
- Pharmaceutical Industry
- NITI Aayog
- DPIIT (Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade)
- CBIC (Central Board of Indirect Taxes & Customs)
- Export-Oriented Units (EoUs)
- Trade Policy
- Banking Directory (IFSC/MICR Codes)
